game_title: Guess Until Right – Mine Cart Tunnel Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the mine cart using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the mine cart is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mine Cart Tunnel'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 19.
